cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys
random.seed(5)
pkts=[]; fid=0
for i in range(2):
    frames=[{'type':'STREAM','id':0,'offset':random.randint(0,10**15),'data_hex':'ab'*20,'fin':False}]
    pkts.append({'level':'A','pn':i,'auth':True,'frames':frames})
dgs=[{'t':0,'op':'key','level':'A','action':'install'},
     {'t':1,'op':'datagram','bytes':1200,'packets':pkts}]
traces=[{'id':'t','config':{'early':False,'overlap':'first','buffer_packets':1024,'idle_ms':0,
  'max_streams_bidi':1024,'max_streams_uni':1024,'max_stream_data':65536,'max_data':4611686018427387903,
  'crypto_limit':65536,'sent':{'I':[],'H':[],'A':[]}},'events':dgs}]
req=json.dumps({'version':1,'traces':traces}).encode()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/entry.py'],input=req,capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
print(p.stdout.decode()[:400]); print(p.stderr.decode()[-300:])
EOF
